result.summary: Found 1 issue: a loading spinner overlay left visible on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image, which appears to be a stuck/unresolved loading state rather than intentional design.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is displayed on top of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image, suggesting the image failed to load or the loading state did not resolve properly.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image loads correctly and the spinner is hidden once loading completes; add a fallback image or error state if loading fails.
